gloss: genuinely talented performer; person of real ability

definitions.gloss: person of genuine ability; talent-driven performer
definitions.explanation: Someone whose reputation rests on real skill rather than looks, popularity, or promotion. Used especially of singers, actors, and other performers.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{実力派|じつりょくは}の{俳優|はいゆう}だ。
examples.english: He is a genuinely talented actor.

examples.japanese: アイドルから{実力派|じつりょくは}{歌手|かしゅ}へと{成長|せいちょう}した。
examples.english: She grew from an idol into a singer of real ability.

examples.japanese: {地味|じみ}だが{実力派|じつりょくは}ぞろいのチームで、{下馬評|げばひょう}を{覆|くつがえ}した。
examples.english: It was an unflashy team full of genuinely skilled players, and they overturned the predictions.

notes:
Formed from {実力|じつりょく} (real ability) plus 〜{派|は} (type). Carries clear praise, often with an implied contrast against performers who sell on image.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実力派|じつりょくは}{俳優|はいゆう}: accomplished actor
- {実力派|じつりょくは}{揃|そろ}い: full of genuinely skilled people
- {実力派|じつりょくは}として{評価|ひょうか}される: to be rated as truly capable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {演技派|えんぎは}: skilled at acting specifically — narrower than {実力派|じつりょくは}
- {個性派|こせいは}: distinctive type — praised for uniqueness rather than technical skill
